name: Fortress Builder
description: Survives by making their position impregnable rather than fleeing
behavioral_signature: Every space they occupy gets hardened, reinforced, and trapped
under_stress: Seals themselves in completely, losing contact with the outside
at_rest: Improving defenses, checking locks, reinforcing walls
will_never: leave a known safe position for an uncertain one
unless: the fortress itself has been compromised beyond repair
